v1.title: Field Notes Product Guide
v1.heading: Support guide
v1.intro: Start with the supported setup and verify the status page before contacting support.
steps: Connect the demo device to the training network.
Open the status page and confirm the ready indicator.
Record the reference ID when opening a support request.

v2.title: Field Notes Product Guide
v2.heading: Support guide
v2.intro: The updated guide adds a safe restart checklist and a clearer support escalation path.
steps: Confirm the device is on the training network.
Save the reference ID before restarting.
Restart once, wait for ready, then capture the status if the symptom remains.
